original_requirement: Immutable model snapshot/version pinned before formal test
limitation: The provider does not document a requestable immutable snapshot. Alias/fingerprint monitoring does not guarantee unchanged model weights or recoverability.
controls: Record actual served alias, system_fingerprint, provider created, request ID, usage and timestamp on every request
Bind non-empty observed backend fingerprint in the reviewed config; missing or changed fingerprint or alias trips shared-client circuit breaker
After a trip stop the batch, retain charged usage and predictions; do not silently continue the next tag
Record official mapping and execution window; keep full dev calibration, resource and candidate freeze gates
Report single-run descriptive results and this reproducibility limitation explicitly
fallback: If the user keeps immutable-snapshot requirement, formal test remains blocked; do not relabel an alias as immutable.
